workload: Exact V1 CLINC test600; shuffled complete cycles, common Poisson arrivals and sample sequence for each repeat/rate across all four conditions
warmup: All64 CLINC development inputs, serial, errors stop before measurement; these are not independent quality data
order: Deterministically shuffle conditions and rates within each repeat before execution
cell_isolation: Fresh owned service and64-input warmup before every cell; stop all owned groups after cell, including after timeout/interruption; startup excluded from offered window and reported separately
quality: Score actual HTTP responses only after all60 completed cells freeze; retrospective previously inspected test; repetitions are not independent quality samples
rates_interpretation: Prespecified common offered-rate levels, not guaranteed light/knee/overload for every service; no tuning or selection from main quality
latency: Scheduled arrival to observed completion, including generator lag, client queue and HTTP; failed admitted requests remain in latency distribution; rejected offers count against SLO
goodput: Timely successful outputs/180s and timely correct outputs/180s; also report successful and correct fractions of all offered requests
drain: Clamp each single HTTP timeout to shared arrival-window+60s deadline. Parent watchdog stops cell and owned services if cell has not exited after another5s; interrupted attempts never become completed cells
resources: Record allocation, CPU model/cpuset, owned process CPU/RSS and NVIDIA device samples; one CPU inference thread is not an exclusive core; allocated GPU cost is not zero for CPU conditions
comparison: Direct services only, no new router, no 9B co-residency claim. Common client admission does not equalize backend schedulers
stopping: Preserve all completed cells including poor results. Interrupted attempts require explicit resume acknowledgment and remain exported; no overwrite or favorable rerun selection
